question: Within the separately selected Ramos validation gene panel, do perturbations with a consistently sensitizing CTL selection effect across at least three Lawson tumor models instead consistently promote resistance in both Ramos in-vitro CAR-T conditions?
claim_limits: not blinded or independent prospective validation
no model fitting, AUC, optimization, clinical inference, or causal attribution of cross-study differences
the nine observed culture-pair values are descriptive envelopes, not confidence intervals or independent donor replication

inputs.role: Official processed guide-count matrix; raw selected read counts
Official publisher supplementary selected validation panel

gene_join: Exact case-sensitive gene-symbol match from workbook Gene to count-matrix Gene.symbol; no aliases, case-folding, sequence-derived labels, or imputing missing as zero.

sample_mapping.matching_rule: Use these outcome-blind source/timepoint pairs from sample_mapping.tsv. Primary is the numerically later CTL timepoint per model; earlier pair is the prespecified consistency check. Require three distinct A/B/C cultures for each arm. Keep Renca-HA source separate from antigen-free Renca IFN-gamma/TNF-alpha arms.

normalization.column_total: sum across all 94,528 guide rows in each count column
normalization.interpretation: exploratory library-normalized log frequency; not published drugZ, MAGeCK, a predictor, or direct percent killing

filter.duplicate_or_missing_keys: excluded and recorded; no label rescue from guide sequence

gene_effect.per_guide: normalized treated culture log-frequency minus normalized control culture log-frequency
gene_effect.per_gene_model_each_timepoint: median across retained guides for each of all 3x3=9 treated-control culture pairs
gene_effect.summary: median, minimum, maximum of the 9 observed pair values; sensitizing iff maximum<0; resistant iff minimum>0; otherwise mixed

baseline_fitness: For each eligible gene/model, descriptive median across retained guides and the three primary control cultures of normalized log-frequency(control)-normalized log-frequency(single source-matched T0); report the single-T0 limitation; do not subtract baseline from the already paired CTL-vs-control effect.

ramos_columns.resistance_rule: positive MAGeCK LFC (enrichment in anti-CD19 relative to control anti-hEGFRvIII) and reported FDR<=0.05 in BOTH E:T contrasts
ramos_columns.in_vivo_columns: excluded from primary because some workbook headers encode anti-CD19 10m versus control 15m dose mismatch

primary_flag: Exact-panel gene is sign-stable sensitizing in at least 3 of 6 latest CTL model contexts AND passes the positive-LFC/FDR rule in both Ramos in-vitro contrasts.
symmetric_descriptive_flag: Sign-stable resistant CTL effect in at least 3 of 6 latest contexts AND Ramos sensitizing (negative LFC, FDR<=0.05) in both in-vitro contrasts; report but do not switch primary.
decision_stop_rules: normalization/source mapping contradicts expected assay direction
protocol_hash_definition: SHA256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON for all protocol fields except protocol_sha256, using sorted keys and compact separators
